description: Undoes the latest bridge_thermal_apply or bridge_thermal_remove run (or the run named): deletes the EC1T_ cases present now and puts back the EC1T_ cases and loads saved before that run, merged into each element's current loads so other cases are kept. Refused in a different model or after a unit change; needs force if EC1T_ loads or the geometry changed since. Previews unless apply: true.
name: bridge_thermal_undo
title: Undo a thermal write or remove
